title: The Stone-Carvers of the Ancient Valley
intro: Imagine a civilization that rose in the rocky valleys of Arabia, skilled in carving magnificent homes from the mountainsides. They flourished with strength and artistry, yet their story is marked by a chilling defiance of divine warning. As you delve into their tale, you will uncover a people whose arrogance led to their utter annihilation. Who were they?
clues: We inherited a land of rocky plains and towering cliffs, where we built our dwellings with unmatched skill.
We were known for carving secure homes into the mountains, feeling safe from any harm.
A messenger came to us from among ourselves, reminding us of Allah's favors and warning us of punishment.
We demanded a sign, and a miraculous she-camel emerged from the rock, a clear test from Allah.
We defied the warning and hamstrung the she-camel, mocking the messenger and challenging the punishment.
A single blast overtook us in our homes, and by morning we lay prostrate, as if we had never lived there.
